mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_conversation ( id, conversation_type, title, created_at, updated_at, version, deleted ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.conversationType}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt}, 0, 0 )

INSERT INTO im_conversation_member ( id, conversation_id, principal_type, principal_id, subject_id, display_name, member_role, joined_at, created_at, updated_at, version, deleted ) VALUES
( #{entity.id}, #{entity.conversationId}, #{entity.principalType}, #{entity.principalId}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.displayName}, #{entity.memberRole}, #{entity.joinedAt}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt}, 0, 0 )
ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, principal_type, principal_id) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO im_message ( id, conversation_id, sender_principal_type, sender_principal_id, sender_subject_id, content_type, content, attachment_file_id, payload_json, status, created_at, version, deleted ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.conversationId}, #{entity.senderPrincipalType}, #{entity.senderPrincipalId}, #{entity.senderSubjectId}, #{entity.contentType}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.attachmentFileId}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{entity.status}, #{entity.createdAt}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.conversation_type, c.title, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.id AND msg.deleted = 0 AND msg.status = #{normalStatus} AND msg.created_at >= m.joined_at AND (m.last_read_message_id IS NULL OR msg.id > m.last_read_message_id) AND NOT (msg.sender_principal_type = m.principal_type AND msg.sender_principal_id = m.principal_id) ) AS unread_count, c.last_message_id, c.last_message_preview, c.last_message_at, c.updated_at FROM im_conversation_member m JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.principal_type = #{principalType} AND m.principal_id = #{principalId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.updated_at) DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT id AS message_id, conversation_id, sender_principal_type, sender_principal_id, sender_subject_id, content_type, content, attachment_file_id, payload_json::text AS payload_json, status, created_at, revoked_at FROM im_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_principal_type, sender_principal_id, sender_subject_id, content_type, content, attachment_file_id, payload_json::text AS payload_json, status, created_at, revoked_at, version, deleted FROM im_message WHERE id = #{messageId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE im_conversation SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message_preview = #{preview}, last_message_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0
